ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What is the main source of energy?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web/energy flow diagram. At the bottom of the diagram there is a sun symbol, and arrows point from the sun to multiple boxes labeled “Producer”; then from the producers, through arrows, they point to “Primary consumer”, and afterward continue to point to “Secondary consumer” and the “Tertiary consumer” at the top. On the right side there is also the label “Decomposers”. Reasoning: In a food web, arrows indicate the direction of energy flow. In the diagram, energy flow starts from the sun, first goes to the producers, and then is passed to consumers at each level. Therefore, the main source of energy is the sun.
